title: Inflating Topic Relevance with Ideology: A Case Study of Political Ideology Bias in Social Topic Detection Models

bias_targets.methodology: Quantifying keyword bias using Pearson Chi-square tests based on the political affiliation of tweet authors (exclusive followers of liberal vs. conservative candidates), and measuring bias propagation in topic detection models (GloVe, ELMo, BERT) by calculating the Blue-versus-Red Log Odds Ratio among the top N retrieved tweets.
